title: PRESSER | Joshua Dye - MSU Postgame (11-27-26)
text: I guess did you know all week, Josh, going into the week that you were kind of the only guy at running back you were you were going to have to carry it? >> Uh, no. I don't come in just expecting the ball or anything or being the only guy. I think Coach Wilson does a good job of prepping all of us. Uh, because you never know. We have five running backs right now with stuff going on with Kan, stuff like that. So, I think we all are prepping to to be that guy and I was that guy tonight and got the opportunity. Obviously, you haven't gotten uh maybe the workload you wanted coming into the season, but the last few weeks have kind of been different for you. Just what do the next upcoming weeks look like for you? >> Uh for me, it's always consistency. No matter who you are, where you're at, um consistency, and you want to build off of it. Um again, like the start of the season didn't go my way, whatever, but I'm in this lab doing what I can do and doing what I can control, and God bless me with this opportunity. What's it like being a new guy and and hearing Tom Luke's speech and kind of getting the the crash course on on what this rivalry means? >> Tom Luke, you could tell like it means something to him. Uh you can feel every little thing that he has when it comes to this cuz uh it was Sunday Sunday morning or Sunday afternoon he come in, he gave us a speech and you can you can feel it. You know, it it goes deep when you hear about this game. just kind of >> how do you you evaluate your own future uh maybe at all miss maybe the transfer portal >> excuse me >> how do you evaluate your your future of the upcoming season? >> I mean I'm not focused on transport or anything. I'm focused on the now and where my toes are at. You know I think God has put me at this spot for a reason has blessed me. So whatever is in front of me and whatever works. So I >> think Will Eckles was the lead blocker on your last touchdown. What did you see a celebration and and what did you think? Yeah, they just showed me on the side uh his little [laughter] Yeah, he's funny. I didn't see it. I would have hit it with him. >> Any other questions for Josh? >> Thanks. Thank you guys.
